run_object_detection_evaluation: run object detection evaluation by comparing predicted bounding boxes against ground truth files
run_evaluate_function: run the evaluate function to compute AP scores for 3D object detection predictions
run_compute_averages: run compute_averages to calculate mean AP at 50% and 25% IoU thresholds across classes
run_print_results: run print_results to display a formatted table of per-class and average AP scores
run_write_result_file: run write_result_file to export per-class AP50 and AP25 scores to a CSV file
